Before you print

  • The shape follows KEF's P1 pad: same footprint, a flare up to a tilted round platform, and one 1/4"-20 screw standing up from an inset disc.
  • The screw goes in from below. Use a 1/4"-20 camera screw (tripod type with a fold-down D-ring) with about 12 mm of thread and a washer up to 18 mm under its head. About 7 mm of thread stands above the disc, as shown.
  • Thread the speaker on by hand and stop if it gets hard. If the screw bottoms out before the speaker is held tight, add a washer under the head.
  • The inset disc takes a 60 mm self-adhesive felt or rubber disc, 1 to 1.5 mm thick, so the speaker is not scratched.
  • The screw position on the pad is taken from KEF's product photo, not measured on a speaker. The speaker block in the view assumes its insert is in the middle of its depth.
  • Print two of the same part, one for the desk side and one for the shelf side.

The four round recesses on the underside are for self-adhesive rubber feet, so the pad does not slide on the desk or shelf.
